europe_now.title: German Cost of Living Protests Turn Violent
europe_now.summary: Recent demonstrations regarding the cost of living in Germany have turned violent, resulting in shops being looted. Protests and civil unrest have spread across multiple European locations.

sources.headline: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent

europe_now.title: Constitutional Showdown in Poland
europe_now.summary: Poland is currently experiencing a significant constitutional showdown involving the judiciary and government leadership. The European Commission has expressed backing for Donald Tusk amid these developments.

sources.headline: Commission backs Tusk as he vows no compromise in court showdown

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Protests Across Europe
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations and protests have drawn hundreds of thousands of participants across France and other parts of Europe. Student unions in France have announced that high school blockades are scheduled to restart on Monday.
